title: Amaranthium (Ihla)
description: The Sixth Installment to the Amaranthium series
body:
Amaranthium (Ihla) adds two enemies, a few weapons and tools and an armour set.

The new enemy is the Star Walker, which can be summoned by right-clicking a Stardust Catalyst.
The second new enemy is a boss, who can be summoned by consuming a stardust beacon, this boss one-taps, and has 1000hp, but drops an item to make one of the most powerful items in this mod.
New Weapons & Tools:
1. Starry Sword
2. Starry Pickaxe
4. Starry Shovel
5. Starry Axe
6. Starry Hoe
7. Rain Bow
8. Jousting Lance
9. Starry Jousting Lance

This mod is the Official Sequel to Amaranthium (Quai)


Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.
Please use Jei/Rei to find the recipies, It will be a lifesaver.
